title: Waste and litter draft-action demonstration policy
source_note: Synthetic portfolio policy approved for this technical demonstration by the human Product Owner on 2026-11-05 with the F27 charter. Version 0.3.0 keeps the 0.2.0 scope, action, evidence and input-integrity rules and adds POL-JURISDICTION-001 (a point in another Tasmanian municipality is rejected with a referral to that council; a point outside every municipality is escalated) and POL-PLACE-001 (an official place name in the text that lies in another municipality more than 2,000 metres from the point is escalated), both against official LIST boundaries (source manifests D7 and D8). It is not City of Hobart, Tasmanian Government, or other council policy.
